name: Heartland
description: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

videos.title: A Heartland Christmas
videos.overview: It’s a week before Christmas and holiday preparations are moving into high gear at Heartland. Lou’s new husband Peter may not be able to spend Christmas with her due to his father’s illness. Amy, Ty, Jack and Tim head out on a rescue mission when an anonymous call is received about starving, abandoned horses trapped in an avalanche. And Caleb and Ashley discover you don’t need expensive gifts to have the perfect Christmas.

videos.title: Coming Home
videos.overview: Amy and Lou Fleming, and their grandfather Jack, deal with life after their mother's death while a new ranch hand, Ty Borden, comes to live and work at Heartland.

videos.title: After the Storm
videos.overview: Lou sends an uncured horse back to its owner, which causes friction with Amy. Ty builds Amy a jumping ring and Jack decides to keep Ty on at Heartland.

videos.title: Breaking Free
videos.overview: High profile horse breeder Lisa Stillman asks Amy to help her with her horse, Promise. Lou holds a Heartland Open House to help bring in business.

videos.title: Taking Chances
videos.overview: Ben Stillman arrives at Heartland and his treatment of his horse Red angers everyone. Ashley lures Ty to Briar Ridge with a job offer.

videos.title: The Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: Lou decides to make a promotional video for Heartland. Ty's new job at Briar Ridge isn't going as planned. Scott gets Amy to help with a wild pony.

videos.title: One Trick Pony
videos.overview: Lou's boyfriend Carl arrives at Heartland with a couple of different proposals for Lou. His welcome, however, is both hot and cold.

videos.title: Come What May
videos.overview: Lou isn't pleased when a neighbouring rancher brings a pregnant mare named Melody to stay at Heartland. Ty is astonished when Jack asks him to join him on a cattle roundup.

videos.title: Out of the Darkness
videos.overview: The pressure is on when a famous race horse, Gallant Prince, is sent to Heartland to see if it can be rehabilitated.

videos.title: Ghost from the Past
videos.overview: An old girlfriend of Ty's shows up at Heartland and stirs up trouble. Lou is reunited with Sugarfoot, Mrs. Bell's miniature horse.

videos.title: Born to Run
videos.overview: Nick Harwell arrives to train Ben but becomes interested in buying Spartan. Mallory thinks Lou plans to re-home Copper and runs away with him, only to discover a plot to sell wild mustangs.

videos.title: Thicker than Water
videos.overview: Tim's visit to Heartland causes sibling rivalry between Lou and Amy. Jack takes Lisa Stillman fishing on their second date.

videos.title: Rising from the Ashes
videos.overview: Disaster strikes when the barn erupts into flames and Jack's badly hurt getting the horses to safety.

videos.title: Coming Together
videos.overview: Amy finds herself working with the enemy when Ashley asks for her help. Amy's also preparing Spartan for the Fall Finale while Lou decides what to do about a job offer in New York.

videos.title: Ghost Horse
videos.overview: It's been four months since Ty's sudden and unexplained departure, and Amy has moved on and become used to working with Caleb Odell, Heartland's new stable hand. With Amy's 16th birthday just days away, Lou is busy planning a surprise birthday party for her sister.

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: When Ty comes back to Heartland, he quickly realizes that profound changes have occurred in his absence. Caleb, the new ranch hand, seems to have taken over both his job and his place in Amy's heart.

videos.title: Gift Horse
videos.overview: When Tim gives Amy a beautiful Grand Prix jumper for her birthday, she's forced to make a difficult choice between a career in show jumping and her work at Heartland.

videos.title: Dancing in the Dark
videos.overview: The spring cattle drive is a much-anticipated event, and Lou hustles everyone out of the house at the crack of dawn for a secret all-day date with Scott. Simmering tensions rise to the surface as Amy seems more interested in getting roping tips from Caleb instead of riding with Ty.

videos.title: Corporate Cowgirls
videos.overview: Lou is forced to reconsider her choice to live and work at Heartland when her former New York colleagues arrive for a weekend equine retreat. Amy is unsure whether she can trust Ty.

videos.title: Holding Fast
videos.overview: Out for a ride along the river, Amy comes across an RCMP officer desperately trying to save a young boy from drowning. Scott misinterprets Nick Harwell's polo match invitation to Lou as a date. Mallory seeks Jack's advice on how to deal with her love life.

videos.title: Sweetheart of the Rodeo
videos.overview: With the annual Hudson Heritage Rodeo looming, everyone at Heartland gets roped into the action. Jack and Tim are forced to work together on the planning committee. Meanwhile, Lou is grooming Soraya to compete in the Queen of The Rodeo competition.

videos.title: Summer's End
videos.overview: In the middle of a heat wave, a cattle truck loaded with thirsty and overheated horses pulls into Heartland. Ty can hardly believe his eyes when the driver turns out to be his dad.

videos.title: Showdown!
videos.overview: Ty asks Amy to give their relationship another chance. Ashley makes a decision that surprises her mother and Lou. Cattle rustlers hit Big River Ranch, and the situation gets out of hand.

videos.title: True Enough
videos.overview: When Amy's teacher brings a horse named Boxer to Heartland, Amy learns a valuable lesson about fathers and daughters. Ty and Kit seem to be blissfully happy together. Lou catches Constable Rodriguez with another woman.

videos.title: Starstruck!
videos.overview: When Hollywood comes to Heartland, Amy is so starstruck, she loses track of what's really important in her life.

videos.title: Divorce Horse
videos.overview: Lisa meddles in Lou's business and personal life with disastrous results. Lisa brings a "cursed" horse for Amy to treat. The beautiful Andalusian named Diva Girl has been returned to Lisa by multiple owners.

videos.title: Seismic Shifts
videos.overview: Lou goes head to head with Big Alberta Oil when seismic surveyors force their way onto Heartland.

videos.title: Do or Die
videos.overview: Clint brings two tough kids on probation to Heartland forcing Ty to deal with a part of his past he'd rather forget.

videos.title: Dark Horse
videos.overview: Lou resurrects the Hudson Derby, stirring up an age-old grudge match between Jack and Tim.

videos.title: The Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Amy resorts to desperate measures when her horse Spartan is mysteriously stolen and reappears sold to Wes, the man who set fire to the Heartland barn.

videos.title: Full Circle
videos.overview: Amy heads into the mountains to visit a First Nations horse healer named Victor Whitetail, and leaves with a new understanding about horses, her mom and herself.

videos.title: Step by Step
videos.overview: Ty and Amy are finally forced to deal with their feelings for each other after a snowstorm strands them at Jack’s fishing cabin in the mountains.

videos.title: Miracle
videos.overview: Amy is thrust into the limelight when she performs a miracle on a traumatized horse and a video of the event is posted online.

videos.title: Little Secrets
videos.overview: Amy finds herself caught in the middle of a family crisis when she tries to help a girl and her horse recover from what appears to be a freak accident.

videos.title: Man's Best Friend
videos.overview: Jack's truck is on its way to rust bucket heaven, forcing him to find the courage to say goodbye to a part of his past.

videos.title: The Haunting of Hanley Barn
videos.overview: Amy and Ty spend the night in the "haunted" Hanley barn, trying to get to the bottom of a mystery.

videos.title: Glory Days
videos.overview: In the hopes of impressing Ashley, Caleb takes lessons in bulldogging from former rodeo champion Tim, who stubbornly refuses to acknowledge that he may no longer have what it takes. Kit and Ty sort out their lingering break-up issues as Ty assists Scott with the delivery of Kit's mare's foal. Lou invites Peter to manage his business from the Heartland facilities while his office undergoes renovation, and lives to regret it.

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: Ty and Amy clash over how best to raise an orphaned foal. Lou must defuse a potential lawsuit after fending off unwanted advances from an unscrupulous business client. Meanwhile, Val tries to connect with her newly-reconciled daughter Ashley and a cougar stalks the Heartland area.

videos.title: The Starting Gate
videos.overview: When Tim buys a racehorse from Lisa, he puts everything on the line, including Amy, to win big.

videos.title: The Fix
videos.overview: Ty protects his mother Lily from his abusive stepfather, who shows up at Heartland to win her back.

videos.title: Broken Arrow
videos.overview: Amy is upset when Ty flies off with Scott to a remote vet call on his last day before heading to vet school.

videos.title: Eye of the Wolf
videos.overview: Amy leads a rescue search to find Ty and Scott, whose plane has gone missing in a remote forested mountain area.

videos.title: Catch and Release
videos.overview: While the boys head off on a fishing trip, the girls are left back at Heartland to deal with the havoc caused by a dog, a porcupine and a herd of escaped cows.

videos.title: The Reckoning
videos.overview: Victor Whitetail visits Heartland, leaving Tim to wonder if Victor was more than just friends with his ex-wife.

videos.title: Quarantine
videos.overview: Relationships are on shaky ground when Kit's horse, Daisy, comes down with Strangles and are put under quarantine. Kit decides to stay at Heartland to be with her horse. But Amy loses it when she finds out that Kit brought Daisy to Heartland almost straight after a rodeo where many horses had come down with strangles! Pegasus catches it and that brings mixed feelings, especially for Tim.

videos.title: The Happy List
videos.overview: Amy and Ty are at odds over his purchase of a vintage motorcycle while Caleb goes off to a rodeo in Montana despite Ashley's growing concerns about his life on the circuit.

videos.title: Second Chances
videos.overview: Amy faces a tough moral dilemma when she discovers Mr. Hanley has abandoned his horses and is on the brink of losing his farm.

videos.title: Spin Out!
videos.overview: Caleb struggles to get over the physical and emotional scars from his terrible accident as Amy tries to get him back on a horse and Tim doles out some tough love.

videos.title: Ring of Fire
videos.overview: When Amy follows in her mother's footsteps and enters a professional colt starting competition her gift with horses, and self-confidence, is put to the test.

videos.title: In the Cards
videos.overview: A surprise announcement by Peter throws Lou's wedding plans into disarray while Amy and Ty are forced to make difficult decisions about their futures.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Amy tries to pretend that nothing has changed when Ty returns to Heartland with a surprise guest.

videos.title: What Dreams May Become
videos.overview: Amy scratches the surface to discover Nick Harwell's problems with his polo ponies, Lou's life in Dubai and Tim's relationship with his jockey are not what they appear to be.

videos.title: Road Curves
videos.overview: When an unspoken attraction re-surfaces, Amy discovers that honesty might be the best policy, but it certainly isn't the easiest one.

videos.title: Graduation
videos.overview: A looming high school graduation and Spartan's near fatal bout with colic forces Amy to face where her future really lies.

videos.title: Where the Truth Lies
videos.overview: When Amy and Ty convince Sarah, the town recluse, to let them treat her sick horse at Heartland, the family helps her face the ghosts of her past..

videos.title: Win, Place or Show
videos.overview: Tim enlists Amy to ride Lightning Dexter in a big time stakes race when he finds out his girlfriend, Janice, has teamed up with the competition

videos.title: Jackpot!
videos.overview: Amy and Kit have to put their differences aside to on Caleb in a team-roping jackpot.

videos.title: One Day
videos.overview: When Amy is hired to do a horse clinic with a group of inmates, Ty is surprised to discover that one of them is a friend from his bad old days at the group home.

videos.title: Local Hero
videos.overview: Lou comes back from Dubai to spend time with the family. Ty and Amy discover where her father's rustled cattle are being pastured and the whole family rides out to bring them back.

videos.title: Mood Swings
videos.overview: When an irate Grant, Ty's travel buddy shows up at Heartland to punch out Ty for "kissing Blair" the disclosure puts Ty and Amy's relationship in jeopardy. Meanwhile finding out that their marriage was not legal puts Caleb and Ashley into a turmoil. All the relationship drama makes Lou question her marriage with Peter.

videos.title: Family Business
videos.overview: Amy fights to keep Dexter in the family when she learns Tim is putting the horse up for sale in a claiming race.

videos.title: Lost Song
videos.overview: Jack is forced to revisit a rough patch in his marriage when he finds an unfinished song by Lyndy in her old guitar case.

videos.title: The Road Home
videos.overview: Jack is forced to revisit a rough patch in his marriage when he finds an unfinished song by Lyndy in her old guitar case.

videos.title: Leap of Faith
videos.overview: Amy must deal with Stewart Forrest's unrealistic expectations when she works with his daughter and an elite jumper that may be too much horse for the girl to handle.

videos.title: The River
videos.overview: Lou helps Amy fight the lawsuit to save her sister's reputation and family business.

videos.title: Never Surrender
videos.overview: When a paralyzed military vet and ex-rodeo cowboy hires Amy to help sell his roping horse she sees an opportunity to re-train both horse and rider

videos.title: Burning Down the House
videos.overview: A horse crazy young boy comes to Heartland and quickly bonds with Amy, but his mother has a secret that could change everything for the Fleming family.

videos.title: Passages
videos.overview: Amy and Ty work through their trust issues as they train a pair of Clydesdale's, but it is an emergency at Heartland that reveals their true strength as a team when it matters most.

videos.title: Finding Freedom
videos.overview: Tim is having no luck tracking down Miranda and Shane since she dropped the bombshell that Shane is his son... until Shane --on his own-- surprises everyone by just showing up at Heartland. And Mallory entertains the idea of going with the recently-single-again Jake to the Spring Fling. There is however --as you might expect with Mallory-- a "but" attached.

videos.title: Something in the Night
videos.overview: When Tim is coerced to go with Jack on a secret mission Amy is left back at Heartland with Janice to get a young race horse ready for his maiden run meanwhile Ty has planned Amy a dinner but there has been an animal hiding in the trailer so they make a slight change of arrangements.

videos.title: What's in a Name?
videos.overview: When Tim reveals to the family that Shane is his son it throws everybody for a loop and threatens to ruin the traditional Bartlett-Fleming-Morris naming ceremony for Lou's baby girl.

videos.title: Beyond Hell's Half Mile
videos.overview: When Amy works with a chuck wagon horse she discovers an impediment that could put the entire team in danger and change the dynamics of a prominent chuck wagon family.

videos.title: Never Let Go
videos.overview: Amy helps to restore the confidence of a troubled, young trick-rider so that she can get back on her horse and perform again.

videos.title: The Slippery Slope
videos.overview: A friend from Jack's past shows up at Heartland when one of their old band mates passes away. Lou & Lisa secretly try to gather the other remaining members for a reunion performance to celebrate Jack's birthday.

videos.title: Over the Rise
videos.overview: When Shane arrives to stay for the summer, Tim tries to impress all three of his kids with a really cool Western day trip.

videos.title: Nothing for Granted
videos.overview: When Ty visits Mrs. Bell to thank her for paying his school fees he and Amy are surprised to learn she’s moved out of her home, and away from Sugarfoot.

videos.title: Cover Me
videos.overview: When Tim's young racehorse Cisco is stolen on the way to his maiden race, Amy and Ty get help tracking him down from an unlikely source – Ty's step-father, Wade.

videos.title: Trust
videos.overview: When Amy bravely tries to heal an abused (and now extremely violent) racehorse Ty and Jack think she's finally bitten off more than she can chew.

videos.title: Fool's Gold
videos.overview: Ty's mother Lily returns to Heartland with shocking news about his father, and a secret that threatens her relationship with her son.

videos.title: Road to Nowhere
videos.overview: When Jack learns Ty is riding his bike solo to a remote lake to spread his father's ashes he decides to surprise Ty and join him for this meaningful road trip.

videos.title: Aftermath
videos.overview: In an attempt to avoid hitting a wolf, Ty is badly injured when he crashes his bike on a remote road, leaving Jack to search for help in the middle of nowhere.

videos.title: Working in a Dream
videos.overview: Amy is roped into helping Tim project a positive image to the community, in hopes it will further his custody case for Shane.

videos.title: Breaking Down and Building Up
videos.overview: When tragedy strikes Amy must find a way to save Mr. Hanley's rescue horses from kill buyers.

videos.title: Wild Horses
videos.overview: Amy and Ty join Scott on a trip back to his old reservation to save a herd of wild horses from the dangerous EHV-1 virus.

videos.title: True Calling
videos.overview: Amy's dog is injured by a rancher, and it's up to Ty to save his life

videos.title: Candles in the Wind
videos.overview: When a mystery horse arrives at Heartland, Amy and Ty are sent down a path that will alter their lives.

videos.title: Running Against the Wind
videos.overview: Amy is bursting to ask Ty about the engagement ring, and why he hasn’t proposed yet, but a couple of “runaways” throw everything at Heartland into turmoil.

videos.title: Crossed Signals
videos.overview: Ty struggles to deal with the fact that Amy has found the engagement ring and has to decide how and whether he is going to propose to her or not.

videos.title: Keeping Up Appearances
videos.overview: Tim hopes for a big commission when he helps a wealthy weekend cowboy look for his dream ranch, while Amy’s stuck teaching his trophy wife how to ride.

videos.title: The Natural
videos.overview: Tim is trying to convince Jack to be his partner in the purchase of a bison bull when Miranda comes to Heartland for a visit and goes on a trail ride with Tim that could totally change their family dynamic.

videos.title: Trial Run
videos.overview: Janice brings Cisco Kid (and her emotional baggage over Tim) to Heartland for Amy to figure out why Cisco's lost that winning feeling.

videos.title: Helping Hands
videos.overview: Amy seeks out an up-and-coming show jumper to learn why he's refusing Scott and Ty's suggested treatment for his horse.

videos.title: Life Is a Highway
videos.overview: Chase Powers returns to Heartland with an aspiring liberty horse rider (Hayley) who wants Amy to be her coach.

videos.title: Do the Right Thing
videos.overview: When Ty needs some engine parts for his broken down truck he's forced to turn to the last person on earth he wants help from - his stepfather, Wade.

videos.title: Great Expectations
videos.overview: A trip to help out an old friend at a fishing camp doesn't go as planned, and a series of unexpected events elevate it into a life-changing weekend for the entire family.

videos.title: The Road Ahead
videos.overview: Amy and Ty hold off telling the family their great news when they return from their trip to find everyone reeling from the devastating fire at Lou and Peter's home.

videos.title: Blowing Smoke
videos.overview: Jeremy forces Amy to make a tough decision about Phoenix when his horse, Buckingham, sustains a serious injury that threatens his jumping career.

videos.title: Playing with Fire
videos.overview: When a local horse show is cancelled Lou saves the day for Georgie and Mallory by stepping up to host it at Heartland.

videos.title: Waiting for Tomorrow
videos.overview: Scott discovers that Spartan has a broken leg and Amy is forced to make the toughest decision of her life.

videos.title: Lost and Gone Forever
videos.overview: Ty's future as a vet is in jeopardy when there's a fatality at Scott's clinic.

videos.title: After All We Have Been Through
videos.overview: In an effort to prove Jeremy was responsible for Buckingham's death, Ty searches for evidence.

videos.title: Born to Buck
videos.overview: Amy is having trouble dealing with a roping horse that only wants to buck and Caleb, who isn't sure he wants to ride broncs anymore.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Amy and Lou help Georgie regain her confidence as a showjumper when Olivia makes her question her place in the family.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: With the threat of losing Phoenix looming over their heads, things become even more complicated at Heartland when Georgie gets a surprise visit from her brother Jeff.

videos.title: Picking Up the Pieces
videos.overview: As the family struggles to cope with recent changes at the ranch, Amy realizes she must reclaim her "Miracle Girl" status and focus on her work with horses.

videos.title: Living the Moment
videos.overview: Amy and Ty find their dream ranch while Peter tries to mediate for Georgie and Olivia.

videos.title: Wrecking Ball
videos.overview: Tim tries to change Maggie's into a soulless fast food franchise putting Lou and Tim on opposite sides.

videos.title: The Penny Drops
videos.overview: Mallory questions her choices when she finds out that Jake is planning to leave while Amy and Ty work with a mare and foal.

videos.title: Thread the Needle
videos.overview: Amy tries to help an RCMP constable fulfill his dream of performing in the RCMP Musical Ride.

videos.title: Now or Never
videos.overview: After seeing a client trick riding, Georgie is determined to pursue it despite Lou's objections.

videos.title: Best Man
videos.overview: Ty is torn between his past and his family at Heartland when an old friend asks him for help.

videos.title: Hotshot
videos.overview: Jack and Georgie end up in a bad situation during a fishing trip.

videos.title: There But for Fortune
videos.overview: Amy's success with a show jumper puts her life at risk.

videos.title: Darkness and Light
videos.overview: Family members are pitted against each other over Amy’s medical treatment as she struggles to come to terms with her injuries and uncertain future.

videos.title: Better Days
videos.overview: Amy is forced to face her fears and save the life of the horse that injured her.

videos.title: Walking Tall
videos.overview: Amy goes under cover to catch a Tennessee Walker's abusers after Ty brings it to Heartland to recover.

videos.title: Lost Highway
videos.overview: Amy works with a horse to help it overcome its fear of water, but sparks fly when Jack learns the horse is owned by a former flame.

videos.title: Things We Lost
videos.overview: Jack and Lisa are lost in the woods, but a trip down memory lane may just help them find their way.

videos.title: Smoke 'n Mirrors
videos.overview: Amy tries to help Tim as he goes through a mid-life crisis and buys a hot horse instead of a traditional hot car.

videos.title: The Comeback Kid
videos.overview: Since her accident, Amy's client list has dwindled to nearly nothing, so she holds a comeback clinic to restart her career.

videos.title: On the Line
videos.overview: Amy and Ty argue over Ty's investment in a horse; Amy begins working with Prince Ahmed.

videos.title: Be Careful What You Wish For
videos.overview: After working with Ty and Caleb's barrel-racing horse, Amy competes in a high-stakes Futurity.

videos.title: There and Back Again
videos.overview: Amy returns from Europe but finds herself struggling to integrate back into life at Heartland and her relationship with Ty.

videos.title: The Big Red Wall
videos.overview: Lou throws herself into party planning and forces Jack to meet with an old acquaintance.

videos.title: Severed Ties
videos.overview: Lavish gifts from afar put more distance between Amy and Georgie.

videos.title: Secrets and Lies
videos.overview: A surprising visitor at Heartland makes a unwelcome declaration. Amy is forced to deal with the devastating consequences.

videos.title: Endings and Beginnings
videos.overview: Amy struggles to pair up some horses. Then is forced to go head to head with a rival trainer.

videos.title: Steal Away
videos.overview: Amy blames Georgie and Jade when a clients horse keeps escaping. She then re-evaluates things when she learns the horse has hidden skills.

videos.title: Walk a Mile
videos.overview: Amy struggles when she tries to help a Hutterite family who's Percherons have run amok during a hayride.

videos.title: The Family Tree
videos.overview: Georgie's life at Heartland could change forever when a school project opens a door.

videos.title: The Pike River Cull
videos.overview: When a threat of a cull looms over a herd of wild horses, Jack and Amy go to the aid of an old friend in Pike River.

videos.title: The Heart of a River
videos.overview: Amy and Ty find themselves drawing closer as they make a desperate bid to save the wild horses.

videos.title: The Silent Partner
videos.overview: A client reveals that Peter turned down a job offer, leaving Amy in a difficult position.

videos.title: Broken Heartland
videos.overview: When Amy is invited to do a horse clinic in Montana, she and Ty decide to take a road trip together, but an unexpected encounter derails their plans.

videos.title: Cowgirls Don't Cry
videos.overview: Tim opens a rodeo school, determined to help young people avoid injury while getting the training they need, but is immediately confronted with a problem student.

videos.title: Riders on the Storm
videos.overview: Amy and Ty help Scott’s nephew realize he is worthy of continuing his family tradition of relay racing.

videos.title: Eclipse of the Heart
videos.overview: Lou returns from Vancouver with an admission that threatens to change the Heartland family forever.

videos.title: Faking It
videos.overview: The family strives to support a devastated Georgie when Lou and Peter are forced to tell her distressing news.

videos.title: All I Need Is You
videos.overview: Lou spearheads preparations for the big day while Amy throws herself into gentling a rescue horse in order to avoid all the craziness.

videos.title: Written in Stone
videos.overview: In order to give Amy and Ty the wedding they really want, Lou struggles to deal with a slew of last minute hurdles.

videos.title: Brave New World
videos.overview: While a dangerous bear lurks near Heartland, Ty and Amy are back from their honeymoon and adding on the loft, Georgie is trying to be able to handle what is going on with Lou and Peter. Amy and Georgie find a hurt horse.

videos.title: Begin Again
videos.overview: As Ty prepares to celebrate an important milestone, he works to treat an abandoned horse’s rain rot while Amy focuses on how to heal the animal’s emotional scars. Jack uses a supposed arthritic knee as an excuse to justify his unwillingness to ride. Lou and Georgie disagree about riding lessons for Katie, but share a genuine mother-daughter moment.

videos.title: Riding for a Fall
videos.overview: After enlisting Amy to help her perfect a trick to perform at an upcoming rodeo, Georgie gets pulled away by Lou and Peter who insist she focus on her schoolwork.

videos.title: Ties of the Earth
videos.overview: Everyone rallies around Jack as he struggles with the inevitable loss of a friend. Georgie gets some unwanted help with her schoolwork.

videos.title: Back in the Saddle
videos.overview: As Amy and Georgie prepare to compete in a cowboy competition, Georgie guilts Jack into helping her train on a new horse in the hopes he will fall in love with the animal.

videos.title: Over and Out
videos.overview: Ty and Amy's attempt to rescue an injured eagle in the mountains takes a dangerous turn.

videos.title: Fearless
videos.overview: Amy helps a Medieval jouster who was badly injured during a competition regain his confidence so he can compete again.

videos.title: Reckless Abandon
videos.overview: Amy's attempts to help Georgie deal with an impending departure are complicated by Olivia.

videos.title: A Matter of Trust
videos.overview: Amy and Ty work together to determine why Caleb’s horse becomes ill during his treatment at Heartland. Meanwhile, Georgie pits her parents against each other to get permission to go on an “away” trip with some girls from the Extreme Team. While Jack and Tim work together to bring the loft up to code as ordered by the insurance inspector, they discover unexpected interlopers.

videos.title: Darkness Before Dawn
videos.overview: Georgie begins to second-guess her decision to run away from Heartland, while the family bands together to find her.

videos.title: Making the Grade
videos.overview: When Ty helps Jack and Tim on a cattle drive, an accident jeopardizes their plans.

videos.title: The Real Deal
videos.overview: Tim asks Amy and Georgie for help to discourage Jade from accepting a suspicious sponsorship deal.

videos.title: Risky Business
videos.overview: Amy and Cass work together to save a racehorse with a career-ending condition, while the arrival of a former girlfriend forces Tim to see his current relationship in a new light.

videos.title: No Regrets
videos.overview: Georgie’s school project on Val Stanton inspires her to take a risk with Adam.

videos.title: Making a Move
videos.overview: When Lou returns from New York she is forced to confront two interlopers: Heartland’s new ranch hand, and a trendy food truck that is threatening Maggie’s business.

videos.title: Pandora's Box
videos.overview: Lou finds herself trapped at the Dude Ranch with Mitch, the new ranch hand, and they both reveal the circumstances of their recent pasts.

videos.title: Love Is Just a Word
videos.overview: While trying to help Cass learn to handle a spirited horse, Amy discovers there is more riding on their success than she initially realized.

videos.title: Resolutions
videos.overview: When their plans to get away are thwarted, Amy and Ty celebrate their first anniversary closer to home and Amy unveils a special surprise.

videos.title: There Will Be Changes
videos.overview: As Amy and Ty prepare for parenthood, they work together to resolve a dangerous pregnancy issue. Meanwhile, Georgie may be forced to give up something she loves when a demanding new Extreme Team coach arrives on the scene. Then, Lou has to decide whether she should tackle a new business venture that may take her away from the Heartland family. When Jack and Mitch work together with the herd, Tim is not ready to be pushed aside. And Georgie and Adam find the perfect way to celebrate an anniversary.

videos.title: You Just Know
videos.overview: Ty performs surgery on a mare, while Amy and the family work to bottle-feed its twin foals.

videos.title: New Kid in Town
videos.overview: Tim is caught in the middle of Jade's showdown with a new hotshot bronc rider.

videos.title: New Horizons
videos.overview: The Heartland family must deal with Amy and Ty's decision about their future.

videos.title: Something to Prove
